name: How should I prepare for a condensation-control assessment?
description: Note where and when moisture appears, clear physical access to attics and crawlspaces, and have recent utility or HVAC maintenance records available.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for a condensation-control assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team inspects your property, take note of when and where the moisture shows up. Document whether sweating happens primarily on cold mornings, after rain, or during specific indoor activities like cooking or commercial operations. Clearing access to crawlspaces, attics, mechanical closets, and perimeter walls helps our technicians inspect framing and insulation without delay. Having recent utility records on hand can also highlight underlying HVAC airflow imbalances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Note where and when moisture appears, clear physical access to attics and crawlspaces, and have recent utility or HVAC maintenance records available.
